_about: Arthur Woollgar Verrall (1851-1912), Fellow of Trinity College, Cambridge: Studies Literary and Historical in the Odes of Horace (Macmillan, 1884), The Bacchants of Euripides and Other Essays (Cambridge, 1910), and the two posthumous collections edited by M. A. Bayfield and J. D. Duff (Cambridge, 1913), raw IA OCR. Editors' rights: J. D. Duff died 1940 and the Literary Essays memoir is by J. W. Mackail (died 1945); M. A. Bayfield's death year is not checked, so life-plus-70 status is unconfirmed for the editorial matter (US public domain by date). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). His editions of Greek plays with facing text are not taken here (Greek-facing measure, Adam's call). No uids minted. Round du (2026-10-23), raw IA: his school Medea (Macmillan, 1892 printing of 1883), the Ion with his English verse translation (Cambridge, 1890; the euripides shelf had refused an earlier scan of it that OCRs as Greek), Euripides the Rationalist (1895) and Essays on Four Plays of Euripides (1905).
